notes: The panel loader can now be tuned from the Options tab, owner-only. Five dials: how tall the panel sits while loading, how long the loader stays up, how fast its animation runs, how long it takes to fade out, and how long the contents take…

Save keeps the values. Save & restart keeps them and replays the loader on every open panel - a genuine reload, so what you are judging is the real startup sequence rather than a re-enactment of it. Defaults puts everything back.
The five numbers used to be written into three different files that had to be changed together. They now live in one place and both the panel and the window-resize animation read the same values.
